about.title: About me
about.lead: Psychologist with clinical training and experience in human talent management.
about.body: Over 3 years of experience in individual psychological care, diagnostic assessment using ICD-10 criteria, and mass recruitment processes for national engineering projects. I combine clinical intervention skills (CBT, crisis intervention) with human resources competencies.
about.population: I work with adults and adolescents seeking to improve their emotional well-being, manage stress, and develop tools to face difficulties.
about.ai: My clinical psychology training allows me to conduct rigorous assessments and accurate diagnoses, while my experience in talent management helps me understand organizational needs and contribute to team well-being.

items.question: What is the first session like?
items.answer: The first session is an initial interview where we learn about your situation, define objectives, and establish a work plan. It's a safe space for you to share what you need.

items.question: Do you offer online or in-person sessions?
items.answer: I offer both modalities. Online therapy is equally effective and allows you to access it from anywhere.

items.question: How long does each session last?
items.answer: Sessions last approximately 50 minutes, although it may vary according to the needs of the process.

items.question: How can I schedule an appointment?
items.answer: You can contact me via WhatsApp or email. I will respond within 24 hours to coordinate the appointment.

desconectar.title: Disconnect to rest
desconectar.description: It's hard to turn off the mind when we feel we must be on alert. The excess of information and news affects our mental health. It's important to release tension before going to sleep and take care of our emotional well-being.

regulacionEmocional.title: Emotional regulation
regulacionEmocional.description: Emotional regulation is the ability to adequately manage emotions that can sometimes overwhelm us. It involves developing strategies to maintain healthy emotional balance and build positive interpersonal relationships.

terapia.title: Going to therapy transforms lives
terapia.description: Therapy helps you understand yourself better, manage your emotions, and grow in personal well-being.

heridasInfancia.title: Childhood wounds
heridasInfancia.description: Childhood experiences such as abandonment or rejection can leave deep scars that affect our relationships and how we see ourselves. Healing is possible and is the first step toward emotional freedom.
